evidence.role: Both terminal-result branches converge on separate sponsor and treasury allocations.
Sponsor release consumes only the complete sponsor bucket.
Treasury release independently transfers and consumes the complete treasury bucket.
The captured claim amount is passed intact to the quote-token transfer helper.

searched.where: Frozen scope: five production files and all 31 dependency-hashes.json paths
searched.result: Read in full; all 31 dependency SHA-256 values matched the manifest.
10 hits covering both callers, the private implementation, flag declaration/getter, duplicate guard, and completion write; no third settlement caller.
11 hits, all in Raffle.sol or IRaffle.sol: declarations, release reads/clears, aggregate accounting, settlement assignments, and getters.
Exactly 4 hits: two interface declarations and two implementations; no wrapper, alternate entrypoint, or internal caller.
Exactly 5 writes: the two bucket clears, settlement completion, and the two settlement allocations.
28 occurrences on 27 lines; withdraw, withdrawal, and collect each returned 0 hits, with no alternate sponsor/treasury payout mechanism.

reasoning: Both NftWon and CashWon settlement branches, whether reached directly or through redemption, atomically allocate separate sponsorProceeds and protocolFees buckets. The two permissionless release functions read, clear, and transfer only their respective complete buckets, so either order works and neither claim gates the other. SafeERC20 failure reverts the bucket clear, and the inherited reentrancy guard resets after each successful call. This is implemented rather than partial because every reachable settlement and release-order path preserves the independence property under the specification’s trusted canonical quote-token assumption.
